items.question: What arises when the hidden true nature is known?
premises: knowing the hidden true nature precedes arising
the verse links knowledge to omniscience
items.inference: Knowing the hidden true nature gives rise to all-knowingness.
uncertainties: exact referent of taṃ depends on prior context
compound parsing of gūḍhasadbhāvaṃ may vary
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
